findings.message: The BFS map uses `if let Ok(Some(...))` around choose_transition, so a dynamically ambiguous transition is silently skipped and the map appears complete. A reader cannot tell that some branches were omitted; counting skipped edges and reporting them would make the diagnostic trustworthy.
